extracted_concepts.name: Grenzwerte und Stetigkeit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Foundation of calculus describing function behavior near points and continuity conditions.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Process of computing the derivative representing instantaneous rate of change.

extracted_concepts.name: Ableitungen höherer Ordnung
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Successive derivatives obtained by differentiating a function multiple times.

extracted_concepts.name: Monotonie und Extrema
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Analysis of increasing/decreasing intervals and local/global maxima/minima.

extracted_concepts.name: Krümmungsverhalten und Wendepunkte
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Study of concavity changes and points where curvature switches sign.

extracted_concepts.name: Kurvendiskussion
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Systematic examination of function properties including domain, limits, and extrema.

extracted_concepts.name: Taylorentwicklung
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Approximation of a function using an infinite sum of terms calculated from derivatives.

extracted_concepts.name: Integration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Process of finding antiderivatives and calculating areas under curves.

extracted_concepts.name: Gewöhnliche Differentialgleichungen 1. Ordnung
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Equations involving a function and its first derivative, solvable via separation of variables.

extracted_concepts.name: Vektoren in R² und R³
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Geometric objects with magnitude and direction in two- and three-dimensional spaces.

extracted_concepts.name: Geradengleichungen und Ebenengleichungen
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Algebraic representations of straight lines and flat surfaces in space.

extracted_concepts.name: Lineare Abbildungen
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Functions between vector spaces preserving vector addition and scalar multiplication.

extracted_concepts.name: Matrizen und Determinanten
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rectangular arrays of numbers and scalar values representing linear transformations.

extracted_concepts.name: Eigenwerte und Eigenvektoren
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Scalars and non-zero vectors that remain parallel after a linear transformation.

extracted_concepts.name: Diagonalisierung
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Process of transforming a matrix into a diagonal form using its eigenbasis.

extracted_concepts.name: Kegelschnitte
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Curves obtained by intersecting a cone with a plane, including ellipses and hyperbolas.

extracted_concepts.name: Komplexe Zahlen
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Numbers extending reals with an imaginary unit i satisfying i² = -1.

extracted_concepts.name: Kombinatorik
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Branch of mathematics studying finite or countable discrete structures and counting.

extracted_concepts.name: Bedingte Wahrscheinlichkeit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Probability of an event occurring given that another event has already occurred.

extracted_concepts.name: Satz von Bayes
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Formula relating conditional and marginal probabilities of random events.

extracted_concepts.name: Zufallsvariablen
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Variable whose possible values are outcomes of a random phenomenon.

extracted_concepts.name: Binomialverteilung
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Discrete probability distribution modeling number of successes in fixed trials.

extracted_concepts.name: Normalverteilung
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Continuous probability distribution characterized by a symmetric bell-shaped curve.

extracted_concepts.name: Erwartungswert
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Long-run average value of repetitions of the experiment it represents.

extracted_concepts.name: Newton-Verfahren
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Iterative algorithm for finding successively better approximations to roots.

extracted_concepts.name: Trapezregel
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Numerical integration technique approximating area using trapezoids.

extracted_concepts.name: Hyperbelfunktionen
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Functions analogous to trigonometric functions but defined using exponentials.

extracted_concepts.name: Polarkoordinaten
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Coordinate system specifying points by distance from origin and angle.

extracted_concepts.name: Umkehrfunktionen
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Functions that reverse the mapping of another function bijectively.

extracted_concepts.name: Statistische Tests
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Procedures using sample data to assess hypotheses about population parameters.

extracted_relations.evidence: Derivative definition fundamentally relies on limit processes.
Higher-order derivatives extend basic differentiation through repeated application.
First derivative test determines monotonicity and critical points.
Second derivative identifies concavity and inflection points.
Comprehensive curve analysis incorporates monotonicity and extremum evaluation.
Taylor series coefficients are derived from successive derivatives at a point.
Fundamental theorem of calculus establishes integration as the inverse of differentiation.
Solving first-order ODEs typically involves direct integration or substitution.
Lines and planes are parameterized using position and direction vectors.
Linear mappings operate on vector spaces and preserve linear structure.
Matrices provide coordinate representations of linear transformations.
Characteristic polynomial computation relies on determinant evaluation.
Diagonalization constructs a basis of eigenvectors to simplify matrix operations.
Conic sections admit elegant polar forms simplifying geometric analysis.
Complex numbers are efficiently multiplied and powered using polar form.
Conditional probability calculations depend on combinatorial counting principles.
Bayes' theorem formalizes updating beliefs using conditional probability rules.
Binomial probabilities are computed using combination formulas for success/failure counts.
Central limit theorem shows normal distribution approximates binomial for large samples.
Expected value is defined as the weighted average over all random variable outcomes.
Root-finding iteration uses tangent line slopes derived from derivatives.
Trapezoidal rule is a numerical quadrature method for definite integrals.
Hyperbolic functions possess power series expansions identical in form to trigonometric ones.
Inverse function theorem links derivative of inverse function to original derivative.
Parametric tests like t-test assume underlying normal distribution of test statistics.
